name: yokoten
description: Rules, guards and skills for AI coding agents: the tool-call guard, doctor at the start of each session, and the yokoten skills and agents.

hooks.command: [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/launch.mjs" ] 2>/dev/null || { echo 'yokoten: this plugin copy is gone; restart Claude Code'; exit 0; }; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/launch.mjs" session "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/yokoten.mjs" doctor --session

[ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/launch.mjs" ] 2>/dev/null || { echo 'yokoten: this plugin copy is gone; restart Claude Code' >&2; exit 2; }; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/launch.mjs" tool "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/yokoten.mjs" hook --commands-only
